executive_summary: Comprehensive overview of Introduction to Aksha
key_value_propositions: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations, enabling proactive responses.
strategic_insights: Live recording and real-time data processing for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities, including monitoring for safety gear and unusual activities.
Customizable alerts allow users to set specific notifications based on detected anomalies.
actionable_recommendations: Flexible deployment options: Aksha can operate on-premise, in the cloud, or in hybrid configurations.
Supports microservices architecture for scalability and resilience using Kubernetes.
Real-time data streaming facilitated by Kafka for timely insights and actions.
